result.planSummary: Format fixture first: trimmed a real PI session file (PI 0.79.1, session version 3) into test/fixtures/pi-session-structure.jsonl with a provenance note, and a conformance helper that derives required shapes from the fixture at runtime. Then materialize over pull output: refactored the pull assembly in thread-view/index.ts into one shared assembleView() that both pull and materialize consume (parity by construction — internal/materialize.ts never sees a DB handle), with entry ids/timestamps derived from message ids, event recorded_at, and view created-at (never write-time clocks; tail rows now carry recorded_at via an event join, and thread_metadata feeds the header — the sanctioned fix-pull's-output path). Added the unknown_format caller error. Then cli/view.ts with the full pinned grammar (five commands, band-override flags merged field-wise before validation, --no-sweep, --json, --out, --format), routed ahead of the shared flag parser so its flags don't widen other commands. Finally the process suite: TC-5.4, parity legs for all five commands on twin fixture threads, the profile-violation and missing-thread nonzero legs, TC-3.3's CLI receipt-shape leg via the shared schema, and the CLI-intake-advances-boundary leg (spawned intake over default max → spawned pull shows abridged flips, spawned status zone ≤ target). Two hash-locked tests amended under the established sanctioned-amendment pattern (Story 2/3 precedent) with the manifest re-recorded.
